tableDescription: Master registry of all customers, capturing identity, segmentation, regional assignment, and account lifecycle status.

columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique numeric identifier for each customer record.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Official business name of the customer organization.
columnDescriptions.customer_type: Business segment classification, such as Enterprise or SMB.
columnDescriptions.customer_level: Tiered value or priority rating assigned to the customer, e.g., A or B.
columnDescriptions.region_id: Foreign key linking the customer to a geographic sales region.
columnDescriptions.signup_date: Date the customer formally enrolled or contracted with the business.
columnDescriptions.is_active: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer account is currently active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: System timestamp recording when the customer record was first inserted.

tableDescription: Monthly aggregated sales performance metrics segmented by region, sales channel, product category, and customer type for business intelligence analysis.

columnDescriptions.data_source: Identifies the originating system or dataset for traceability and multi-source management.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent record update.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted.
columnDescriptions.data_end_date: End date of the source data extraction window in YYYYMMDD format.
columnDescriptions.data_start_date: Start date of the source data extraction window in YYYYMMDD format.
columnDescriptions.avg_order_amount: Average net revenue per order within the segment.
columnDescriptions.unit_cost_avg: Average cost per unit sold within the segment.
columnDescriptions.profit_rate: Net profit as a proportion of net revenue; the profit margin ratio.
columnDescriptions.avg_discount_rate: Average discount percentage applied to orders in the segment.
columnDescriptions.avg_unit_price: Average selling price per unit after discounts are applied.
columnDescriptions.stat_month: Calendar month this summary record represents.
columnDescriptions.region_id: Numeric identifier for the sales region.
columnDescriptions.region_name: Name of the geographic sales region.
columnDescriptions.channel_name: Sales channel classification such as Direct, Partner, or Online.
columnDescriptions.customer_type: Customer segment classification such as Enterprise, SMB, or Individual.
columnDescriptions.order_cnt: Total number of orders within the segment for the month.
columnDescriptions.row_cnt: Number of source data rows aggregated into this record.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Total units sold within the segment for the month.
columnDescriptions.gross_amount: Total revenue before discounts are applied.
columnDescriptions.net_amount: Total revenue after discounts are applied.
columnDescriptions.cost_amount: Total cost of goods sold for the segment.
columnDescriptions.profit_amount: Total profit after deducting costs from net revenue.

tableDescription: Dimension table storing geographic sales regions, their hierarchy levels, and responsible managers for Chinese business operations.

columnDescriptions.region_id: Unique numeric identifier for each geographic region.
columnDescriptions.region_name: Chinese name of the region, such as East or South China.
columnDescriptions.region_level: Hierarchical tier of the region, such as major zone or sub-region.
columnDescriptions.manager_name: Full name of the person accountable for the region.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp recording when this region record was initially created.

tableDescription: Records individual sales transactions including pricing, discounts, costs, and profit across customers, products, regions, and sales channels.

columnDescriptions.order_id: Unique identifier for each sales transaction.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Calendar date when the customer placed the order.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: References the customer who placed the order.
columnDescriptions.product_id: References the product purchased in the transaction.
columnDescriptions.region_id: References the geographic sales region associated with the order.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of product units purchased in the order.
columnDescriptions.unit_price: Selling price per single unit before any discount is applied.
columnDescriptions.discount_rate: Proportional discount applied to the order; 0.05 equals 5% off.
columnDescriptions.gross_amount: Pre-discount revenue; quantity multiplied by unit price.
columnDescriptions.net_amount: Actual billed revenue after the discount rate is applied.
columnDescriptions.cost_amount: Total cost of goods sold for the order.
columnDescriptions.profit_amount: Financial gain from the order; net amount minus cost.
columnDescriptions.order_status: Current fulfillment state of the order, e.g., completed or pending.
columnDescriptions.channel_name: Sales channel through which the order was placed, e.g., Direct or Online.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the order record was inserted into the system.

tableDescription: A catalog of sellable products with pricing, categorization, cost, and availability status.

columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique numeric identifier for each product.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Full commercial name of the product offering.
columnDescriptions.category_name: Top-level classification grouping products into broad types.
columnDescriptions.subcategory_name: Secondary classification within a category for finer segmentation.
columnDescriptions.unit_price: Customer-facing selling price charged per unit.
columnDescriptions.unit_cost: Internal cost to produce or acquire one unit.
columnDescriptions.is_active: 1 means currently on sale; 0 means discontinued or hidden.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the product record was first created.

tableDescription: Staging table for Tableau Prep containing periodic financial statement metrics by entity, account, and reporting period.

columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent record modification.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first created.
columnDescriptions.etl_batch_id: Identifier linking the record to its ETL ingestion batch.
columnDescriptions.stats_date: Exact date associated with the reported statistics.
columnDescriptions.period_amount: Financial metric value for the specific reporting period.
columnDescriptions.stats_yyyymm: Year and month of the statistics in YYYYMM format.
columnDescriptions.stats_year: Calendar year of the reported statistics.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Label describing the reporting period (e.g., monthly, quarterly).
columnDescriptions.report_period_range: Start and end date range covering the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.entity_code: Short code uniquely identifying the business entity.
columnDescriptions.entity_name: Full name of the business entity or organizational unit.
columnDescriptions.statement_section: Section of the financial statement the line item belongs to.
columnDescriptions.line_level: Hierarchical depth of the line item within the statement.
columnDescriptions.line_order: Numeric sort order for displaying line items sequentially.
columnDescriptions.line_code: Unique code identifying a specific financial statement line.
columnDescriptions.account_code: Code identifying the associated general ledger account.
columnDescriptions.account_name: Descriptive name of the associated general ledger account.
columnDescriptions.indicator_name: Name of the financial or performance indicator being measured.
columnDescriptions.indicator_unit: Unit of measurement for the indicator (e.g., currency, percentage).
columnDescriptions.ytd_amount: Cumulative financial amount from the start of the year.
columnDescriptions.load_time: Timestamp when the record was loaded into staging.
columnDescriptions.data_source: Name or identifier of the originating upstream data system.

tableDescription: Financial balance sheet fact table storing period-start and period-end balances per line item, entity, and reporting period.

columnDescriptions.stats_date: First day of the accounting month representing the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.stats_yyyymm: Year-month identifier (YYYYMM) for the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.stats_year: Fiscal year extracted from the statistics date.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Standardized report type label: Q1, mid-year, Q3, or annual.
columnDescriptions.report_period_range: Start-to-end month range covered by the report period.
columnDescriptions.entity_name: Legal name of the accounting and reporting entity.
columnDescriptions.entity_code: Unique identifier code for the reporting entity.
columnDescriptions.statement_section: Balance sheet category: current assets, liabilities, non-current, or equity.
columnDescriptions.line_level: Hierarchy depth level of the balance sheet line item.
columnDescriptions.line_order: Sequential number controlling the display order of line items.
columnDescriptions.line_code: Unique configuration code assigned to each balance sheet indicator.
columnDescriptions.account_code: ERP source system chart-of-accounts code for the line item.
columnDescriptions.account_name: Official account name from the chart of accounts.
columnDescriptions.indicator_name: Front-end display label for the balance sheet line item.
columnDescriptions.indicator_unit: Measurement unit for reported values, typically currency or percentage.
columnDescriptions.opening_balance: Account monetary balance at the start of the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.ending_balance: Account monetary balance at the close of the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.data_source: Origin system or file providing the financial statement data.
columnDescriptions.load_time: Timestamp of the most recent ETL data load or refresh.
columnDescriptions.etl_batch_id: ETL pipeline batch identifier enabling reconciliation and issue tracing.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when this record row was first inserted.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when this record row was last modified.

tableDescription: Cash flow statement fact table storing periodic line-item amounts by entity, reporting period, and indicator hierarchy.

columnDescriptions.stats_date: First day of the accounting month for the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.stats_yyyymm: Year-month identifier of the accounting period.
columnDescriptions.stats_year: Fiscal year extracted from the accounting period.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Standardized financial report type: Q1, interim, Q3, or annual.
columnDescriptions.report_period_range: Start-to-end month range covered by the report period.
columnDescriptions.entity_name: Legal name of the reporting company or business entity.
columnDescriptions.entity_code: Internal identifier code for the reporting entity.
columnDescriptions.statement_section: Cash flow category: operating, investing, or financing activities.
columnDescriptions.line_level: Hierarchy depth of the line item within the statement structure.
columnDescriptions.line_order: Display sequence for ordering line items in reports.
columnDescriptions.line_code: Unique configuration code assigned to each financial indicator.
columnDescriptions.account_code: ERP system account code; may be empty in current stage.
columnDescriptions.account_name: ERP account name serving as the unique key for each line item.
columnDescriptions.indicator_name: Front-end display label for the financial line item.
columnDescriptions.indicator_unit: Measurement unit, typically currency (元) or percentage.
columnDescriptions.ytd_amount: Year-to-date cumulative cash flow amount for the indicator.
columnDescriptions.period_amount: Current period cash flow amount for the indicator.
columnDescriptions.data_source: Origin system or report supplying the financial data.
columnDescriptions.load_time: Timestamp when the ETL process loaded this record.
columnDescriptions.etl_batch_id: ETL job batch identifier used for reconciliation and troubleshooting.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the table.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent update to this record.

tableDescription: Profit and loss fact table storing periodic financial statement line items by entity, reporting period, and account indicator.

columnDescriptions.stats_date: First day of the accounting month representing the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.stats_yyyymm: Year-month identifier for the accounting period in YYYYMM format.
columnDescriptions.stats_year: Calendar year extracted from the statistics date.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Standardized reporting cycle label: quarterly, semi-annual, or annual report.
columnDescriptions.report_period_range: Start-to-end month range covered by the report period, formatted YYYYMM-YYYYMM.
columnDescriptions.entity_name: Full legal name of the accounting entity being reported on.
columnDescriptions.entity_code: Unique numeric identifier for the accounting entity.
columnDescriptions.statement_section: High-level P&L category grouping line items, e.g., revenue or cost.
columnDescriptions.line_level: Hierarchy depth of the financial line item within the report structure.
columnDescriptions.line_order: Display sequence number controlling sort order of indicators on reports.
columnDescriptions.line_code: Internal configuration code uniquely identifying each financial indicator.
columnDescriptions.account_code: ERP-sourced general ledger account code; may be empty currently.
columnDescriptions.account_name: General ledger account name; serves as the natural deduplication key.
columnDescriptions.indicator_name: Front-end display label shown for the financial metric.
columnDescriptions.indicator_unit: Unit of measurement for the indicator, typically CNY yuan or percentage.
columnDescriptions.ytd_amount: Cumulative year-to-date monetary value for the indicator.
columnDescriptions.period_amount: Single-period monetary value for the current reporting interval.
columnDescriptions.data_source: Origin system supplying the financial data, e.g., EBS_PL.
columnDescriptions.load_time: Timestamp when the ETL process last loaded or refreshed this record.
columnDescriptions.etl_batch_id: ETL job batch identifier used for reconciliation and troubleshooting.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the table.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the record.

tableDescription: Hospital medical revenue accrual records tracking charges by department, doctor, visit type, and billing category for financial reporting.

columnDescriptions.date: Date on which the patient visit or medical service occurred.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name or campus of the hospital where care was delivered.
columnDescriptions.visit_department: Clinical department where the patient physically received treatment.
columnDescriptions.finance_department: Accounting department responsible for cost allocation and revenue booking.
columnDescriptions.visit_type: Outpatient, inpatient, or emergency classification of the encounter.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Attending physician who provided the clinical service.
columnDescriptions.visit_content: Specific clinical purpose or procedure performed during the visit.
columnDescriptions.bill_subtype: High-level billing category used to classify the charge type.
columnDescriptions.order_subtype: Secondary classification of the medical order for financial reporting.
columnDescriptions.order_item: Specific billable service item or procedure charged to the patient.
columnDescriptions.amount: Revenue amount accrued for the service item in local currency.

tableDescription: Daily inpatient admission counts by hospital branch, department, doctor, and admission category.

columnDescriptions.date: Calendar date on which the inpatient admissions were recorded.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital branch or campus where admissions occurred.
columnDescriptions.visit_department: Clinical department that clinically managed and treated the inpatient.
columnDescriptions.finance_department: Department responsible for billing and financial accounting of the stay.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Attending physician's name assigned to the inpatient admissions.
columnDescriptions.admission_type: Classification of the stay, e.g., day, regular, or obstetric inpatient.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Count of inpatient admissions for the given date and attribute combination.

tableDescription: Daily outpatient visit records across hospital departments, tracking patient volume, doctor assignments, and new customer status by multiple dimensions.

columnDescriptions.date: Calendar date on which the outpatient visits occurred.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital branch or campus where visits took place.
columnDescriptions.visit_department: Clinical department where the patient physically received care.
columnDescriptions.finance_department: Department used for billing and financial classification of the visit.
columnDescriptions.visit_content: Specific type of medical service or treatment provided during the visit.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the attending physician who provided care.
columnDescriptions.is_group_new_customer: Y/N flag indicating if the patient is new to the entire hospital group.
columnDescriptions.is_hospital_new_customer: Y/N flag indicating if the patient is new to this specific hospital.
columnDescriptions.is_dept_new_customer: Y/N flag indicating if the patient is new to this department.
columnDescriptions.employee_flag: Distinguishes hospital employees from general non-employee patients.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Total outpatient visit count for this combination of dimension values.

tableDescription: Stores individual question-answer pairs from patient satisfaction surveys submitted across hospital departments and doctors.

columnDescriptions.survey_id: Unique identifier linking all answers belonging to one survey submission.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department where the patient received care.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the treating physician associated with the survey.
columnDescriptions.submit_date: Date the patient submitted the satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Branch or campus where the patient visit occurred.
columnDescriptions.survey_name: Full title of the satisfaction questionnaire administered to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_id: Short code identifying a specific question within the survey form.
columnDescriptions.question_text: Full wording of the survey question presented to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_category: Numeric grouping that classifies the question into a survey section.
columnDescriptions.question_type: Service area or staff type the question evaluates, e.g., doctor, ultrasound.
columnDescriptions.answer: Patient's response to the corresponding survey question.
columnDescriptions.standard_hospital: Normalized hospital name for consistent cross-branch reporting and analysis.

tableDescription: Daily hospital revenue settlement records broken down by branch, department, fee category, and payment method.

columnDescriptions.date: Calendar date on which the settlement transaction was recorded.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital branch or campus where the revenue was collected.
columnDescriptions.finance_department: Clinical or administrative department generating the settled revenue.
columnDescriptions.fee_type: Charge category, such as product, package, stored-value card, or bill.
columnDescriptions.payment_method: How the patient paid: cash, bank card, remittance, etc.
columnDescriptions.amount: Total monetary value settled for the given date and category combination.

tableDescription: View of patient survey responses focused on wait time perception questions across hospital departments and branches.

columnDescriptions.survey_id: Unique identifier for each individual patient survey submission.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department where the patient received care.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the attending physician seen by the patient.
columnDescriptions.submit_date: Date the patient submitted the satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital branch or campus where care was received.
columnDescriptions.survey_name: Full title of the patient satisfaction survey administered.
columnDescriptions.question_id: Unique code identifying the specific survey question.
columnDescriptions.question_text: Full text of the wait time question posed to patients.
columnDescriptions.question_category: Numeric category grouping this question belongs to.
columnDescriptions.question_type: Classification type of the survey question format.
columnDescriptions.answer: Patient's selected response to the wait time question.
columnDescriptions.standard_hospital: Normalized hospital branch name for consistent cross-branch reporting.

tableDescription: Aggregated patient satisfaction survey results per doctor, department, and hospital, grouped by submission date and month.

columnDescriptions.submit_date: The date on which patient surveys were submitted and recorded.
columnDescriptions.month: Year-month period the survey results are attributed to.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital branch where the doctor is stationed.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department within the hospital that the doctor belongs to.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Full name of the individual doctor being evaluated by patients.
columnDescriptions.survey_count: Total number of patient satisfaction surveys submitted for this doctor.
columnDescriptions.very_satisfied_count: Number of patients who responded with the highest satisfaction rating.
columnDescriptions.valid_answer_count: Number of submitted surveys containing valid, scoreable responses.
columnDescriptions.very_satisfied_rate: Proportion of very satisfied responses out of all valid answers.

tableDescription: Detailed view of patient survey responses per question, linked to doctor, department, and hospital.

columnDescriptions.survey_id: Unique numeric identifier for each completed patient satisfaction survey submission.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department where the patient received care during the visit.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the physician associated with the patient's survey.
columnDescriptions.submit_date: Date the patient submitted the satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital branch or campus name where the service was provided.
columnDescriptions.survey_name: Full title of the patient satisfaction questionnaire administered.
columnDescriptions.question_id: Unique code identifying a specific question within the survey.
columnDescriptions.question_text: Verbatim text of the survey question presented to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_category: Numeric category grouping questions by topic within the survey.
columnDescriptions.question_type: Classification of question format, such as rating scale or open-ended.
columnDescriptions.answer: Patient's free-text or selected response to the survey question.
columnDescriptions.standard_hospital: Normalized hospital name used for consistent cross-branch reporting and analysis.

tableDescription: Detailed view of patient satisfaction survey responses, capturing per-question answers for less-than-fully-satisfied feedback analysis across hospital branches.

columnDescriptions.survey_id: Unique identifier for each patient-submitted satisfaction survey instance.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department where the patient received care, e.g., Obstetrics.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the treating or responsible doctor linked to the survey.
columnDescriptions.submit_date: Date the patient submitted the satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital branch or campus where the patient visit occurred.
columnDescriptions.survey_name: Full title of the satisfaction survey questionnaire administered to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_id: Short code identifying a specific question within the survey.
columnDescriptions.question_text: Full wording of the satisfaction question presented to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_category: Numeric code grouping questions into broader satisfaction categories.
columnDescriptions.question_type: Topic label classifying the service aspect evaluated, e.g., environment, breakfast.
columnDescriptions.answer: Patient's selected satisfaction rating or response for the question.
columnDescriptions.standard_hospital: Normalized hospital branch name used for consistent cross-branch reporting.

tableDescription: Monthly Net Promoter Score metrics aggregated by hospital campus and department, tracking patient survey satisfaction.

columnDescriptions.month: Reporting period in YYYY-MM format for monthly NPS aggregation.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital campus or branch where patient surveys were collected.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department or care unit within the hospital campus.
columnDescriptions.nps_answer_count: Total number of valid NPS survey responses received in the period.
columnDescriptions.promoter_count: Number of survey respondents classified as promoters (high satisfaction).
columnDescriptions.detractor_count: Number of survey respondents classified as detractors (low satisfaction).
columnDescriptions.nps: Net Promoter Score ratio: (promoters minus detractors) divided by total responses.

tableDescription: Monthly patient survey recovery rates broken down by hospital campus, department, and visit type.

columnDescriptions.month: Year-month reporting period for survey and visit data aggregation.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital campus or branch location.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical specialty or department within the hospital.
columnDescriptions.visit_type: Classification of patient visit, such as outpatient or inpatient.
columnDescriptions.survey_count: Number of patient satisfaction surveys collected during the period.
columnDescriptions.visit_count: Total patient visits recorded during the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.recovery_rate: Proportion of visits that resulted in a completed survey response.
